title: veronica multifida subsp. capsellicarpa
intro: Veronica multifida subsp. capsellicarpa, commonly known as the "Cape Veronica", is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Veronica multifida subsp. capsellicarpa include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
